2608.18661.title: X2Streaming-TTS: Causal Token-Level Text-to-Speech from Streaming Text with Speech-State Inheritance
2608.18661.paper_summary: Streaming text-to-speech is essential for low-latency spoken dialogue systems, yet many systems wait for sentence-level text and are therefore only pseudo-streaming. True token-level synthesis must generate speech from uncertain prefixes while maintaining perceptual continuity over an unbounded stream with bounded context. We present X2Streaming-TTS, a causal TTS framework that consumes asynchronously arriving text tokens and emits speech without accessing future input. To handle uncertain prefixes, we introduce causal commitment, which keeps ambiguous expressions provisional through uncertainty-aware buffering and performs capacity-adaptive, punctuation-aware segmentation. To preserve acoustic continuity, we further introduce causal speech-state inheritance, which carries the complete Code2Wav state and selected historical Talker states across segment boundaries. Together with an attention prior constraint, it blocks access to future positions while retaining bounded acoustic context. Experiments show that X2Streaming-TTS outperforms existing pseudo-streaming models on most subjective and objective metrics. Further analysis shows that causal commitment stabilizes online segmentation and reduces failures caused by insufficient context, while speech-state inheritance improves boundary continuity without degrading naturalness or speaker identity. X2Streaming-TTS thus achieves strict token-level synthesis with quality comparable to the evaluated offline baselines, a median time to first audio token (TTFT) of 15.8 ms for a single request, and a median TTFT of 260.8 ms at 128 concurrent requests. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/X-Square-Robot/X2Streaming-TTS .
2608.18661.paper_summary_zh: 串流文本轉語音對於低延遲的口語對話系統至關重要，然而許多系統僅等待句子級別的文本，因此僅為偽串流。真正的標記級合成必須從不確定的前綴生成語音，同時在有界上下文中保持對無界串流的感知連續性。我們提出了X2Streaming-TTS，一個因果TTS框架，能夠異步消耗到達的文本標記並在不訪問未來輸入的情況下發出語音。為了處理不確定的前綴，我們引入了因果承諾，通過不確定性感知緩衝保持模糊表達的臨時性，並執行容量自適應和標點符號感知的分段。為了保持聲學連續性，我們進一步引入了因果語音狀態繼承，這會在段邊界之間攜帶完整的Code2Wav狀態和選定的歷史說話者狀態。結合注意力先驗約束，它阻止訪問未來位置，同時保留有界的聲學上下文。實驗表明，X2Streaming-TTS在大多數主觀和客觀指標上優於現有的偽串流模型。進一步分析顯示，因果承諾穩定了在線分段，並減少了由於上下文不足而造成的失敗，而語音狀態繼承則在不降低自然性或說話者身份的情況下改善了邊界連續性。因此，X2Streaming-TTS實現了嚴格的標記級合成，其質量可與評估的離線基準相媲美，單次請求的首次音頻標記的中位時間（TTFT）為15.8毫秒，128個並發請求的中位TTFT為260.8毫秒。我們的實現可在https://github.com/X-Square-Robot/X2Streaming-TTS上公開獲得。
